title: The Signature Approach to Photonic Computing Architecture (Signature)
provenance: Signature original design work by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled original designs and improvements — original work, not presented as established public fact.
description: The Signature approach integrates everything: a compute-optimized photonics PDK, self-calibrating meshes, athermal rings, and a noise-aware compiler — then ships it as a rack appliance. Photonic AI becomes a product, not a paper. This is Signature original work by Justin Addam Higgins: an original design direction for Photonic Computing Architecture, labeled as Signature throughout, and never presented as established public fact. Signature photonic computing arrives as an inference appliance: slide it in the rack, deploy the model, and serve at a tenth the energy. The mesh calibrates itself, the compiler guarantees accuracy, and the wall-plug meter proves the savings.
key_points: Signature direction: The Signature approach integrates everything: a compute-optimized photonics PDK, self-calibrating meshes, athermal rings, and a noise-aware compiler — then ships it as a rack appliance.
Signature vision: Signature photonic computing arrives as an inference appliance: slide it in the rack, deploy the model, and serve at a tenth the energy.
Original work: designed by Justin Addam Higgins, Signature-labeled throughout.
